decisive_items: repeat imaging demonstrated reduction of free air
response.rationale: Recurrent pneumoperitoneum is directly supported by repeated free intraperitoneal air without perforation and rapid resolution; chronic pseudo-obstruction explains urinary retention and pain but not free air; Moyamoya is unrelated.

rejected.why: Moyamoya is a vascular history item, not the cause of recurrent free air.
Chronic pseudo-obstruction can cause pain and urinary retention but does not account for recurrent free intraperitoneal air.
